title: Pickup slot can be overbooked when two customers book the last place at the same time
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Set pilot store slot cap to 3. 2. Book two orders into the 8:00 slot. 3. On two devices select 8:00 and tap Pay within the same second.
expected: Second customer sees 'Full' and cannot book
actual: Both orders accepted; slot holds 4 orders
resolution: Vendor added a capacity check at payment time; retested in cycle 2 and passed

title: Unavailable milk option can still be selected
steps_to_reproduce: 1. In store admin mark oat milk unavailable. 2. In app open a latte at the pilot store. 3. Open milk options.
expected: Oat milk greyed out with 'Not available today'
actual: Oat milk selectable and order accepted
resolution: Availability cache now refreshes on store change; retested in cycle 2 and passed

title: Report shows ready-to-collect time without a unit
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Place and collect orders in the pilot store. 2. Next morning open the app order report.
expected: Average ready-to-collect time shown in minutes with unit
actual: Value shown in seconds with no unit label
resolution: Accepted by sponsor for next release; workaround: divide by 60
